clusters.headline: Investigation Expands Into Illegal Wiretapping Of President Prabowo
aiSummaryBullets: Police are investigating the origins of orders behind the illegal wiretapping of President Prabowo Subianto.
Bareskrim Polri continues to identify new suspects and roles, including senior officials involved in the breach.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Volcanic Activity Reported At Semeru, Bromo And Dukono
aiSummaryBullets: Mount Semeru released hot ash clouds reaching 5.5 kilometers in a southeasterly direction early Saturday.
Mount Bromo has seen ongoing eruptive activity, leading officials to impose a one-kilometer exclusion zone for visitors.

clusters.headline: Former President Joko Widodo Addresses Diploma Allegations In Court
aiSummaryBullets: Joko Widodo displayed his undergraduate diploma during a defamation trial involving Roy Suryo.
Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) provided responses regarding the authenticity of the former president's academic records.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Institutions And Regional Governments Receive Awards
aiSummaryBullets: Regional governments across Indonesia were recognized for innovations in economic growth, public services, and digital transformation.
National institutions, including the Secretariats of the DPR and DPD RI, received honors for institutional development and public communications.

clusters.headline: Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia Manages Strategic Resource Exports
aiSummaryBullets: Export processes for coal, palm oil, and ferroalloy will shift to the Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia platform beginning January 1, 2027.
Danantara Sumberdaya Indonesia will act as an intermediary for data and fair price regulation without purchasing the exported commodities.

clusters.headline: Authorities Investigate Viral Child Abuse Footage In West Kalimantan
aiSummaryBullets: Law enforcement officials in Ketapang are currently investigating a video showing a woman physically harming her four-year-old child.
The footage of the alleged assault, captured via security cameras, has been circulated on social media platforms.

clusters.headline: Military Helicopter Crew Recovered Following Fatal Crash In Kalteng
aiSummaryBullets: Recovery operations have concluded for three military personnel who died in a helicopter crash during forest fire suppression efforts in Kalteng.
The helicopter was successfully retrieved from the water using tugboat assistance, and the flight data recorder has been secured.

clusters.headline: Women's March Participants Present Nine Demands In Jakarta Protest
aiSummaryBullets: Protesters organized in central Jakarta under the theme of opposing state oppression.
The demonstration centered on nine specific demands covering gender, economy, and human rights.

clusters.headline: CNN Indonesia Awards 2026 Honors Various Regional Achievements
aiSummaryBullets: The CNN Indonesia Awards 2026 ceremony took place in Jakarta on November 6, featuring high-ranking government officials and regional leaders.
Award recipients included the Central Java Provincial Government for economic growth and PT Astra International for rural empowerment initiatives.

clusters.headline: Allegations Of Unauthorized Surveillance Target President Prabowo
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto summoned the head of the National Intelligence Agency following reports of illegal wiretapping activities.
The head of the National Intelligence Agency characterized the alleged surveillance by former police leadership as acts bordering on treason.
